// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// A method on a non-Service receiver type is out of scope. Only
// the *Service surface forms the wails-bypass ingress class that
// Cerberus #24 Finding 2 calls out.

package fixture

type Helper struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// Build belongs to Helper, not Service — even with an unguarded
// PathJoin it does not count under this rule.
func (h *Helper) Build(id string) string {
	return PathJoin("/data", id)
}
